metadata.title: Security Assessment Results - Email Campaign Platform (Medicine Advancement Communications)
metadata.remarks: Assessment results for the Medicine Advancement Communications instance of the Email Campaign Platform. This SAR documents a governance deviation related to branding template inheritance.

objectives.title: Institutional Branding Governance
objectives.description: Ensure public communications adhere to approved institutional branding requirements.

results.title: Assessment Result - Branding Governance (Medicine Advancement)
results.description: Assessment of institutional branding controls for the Medicine Advancement Communications Email Campaign Platform instance.

findings.title: Local Branding Templates Not Centrally Inherited
findings.description: This instance does not use centrally approved branding templates. Instead, locally authored templates are used, which do not automatically inherit institutional branding updates or attestations.

related-observations.description: Branding templates are created and maintained locally by Medicine Advancement Communications.

associated-risk.title: Potential Branding Inconsistency
associated-risk.description: Locally maintained templates may diverge from institutional branding standards over time, creating reputational risk.

remediations.title: Branding Governance Alignment Plan
remediations.description: Establish governance mechanisms to ensure locally developed templates remain aligned with institutional branding requirements.
remediations.remarks: This is a governance remediation rather than a technical control failure.

tasks.title: Document Local Branding Checklist
tasks.description: Create a documented checklist aligning local branding practices with institutional standards.

tasks.title: Establish Branding Attestation Process
tasks.description: Implement an annual branding attestation with central Communications.

tasks.title: Evaluate Optional Central Template Inheritance
tasks.description: Assess feasibility of selectively inheriting centrally approved templates for future campaigns.
